an8.43:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde.
an8.43:1.2: Atha kho Visākhā Migāramātā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Visākhaṃ Migāramātaraṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an8.43:1.3: Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato Visākhe uposatho upavuttho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.43:1.4: Kathaṃ upavuttho ca Visākhe aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro? 3.
an8.43:1.6: ‘yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharanti,
an8.43:1.7: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharāmi,
an8.43:1.8: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.43:1.9: Iminā paṭhamena aṅgena samannāgato hoti . . . pe . . .
an8.43:2.1: ‘Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.43:2.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.43:2.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.43:2.5: Evaṃ upavuttho kho Visākhe aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.43:3.1: Kīva mahapphalo hoti kīva mahānisaṃso kīva mahājutiko kīva mahāvipphāro? 4.
an8.43:3.2: Seyyathā pi Visākhe yo imesaṃ soḷasannaṃ mahājanapadānaṃ pahūtasattaratanānaṃ issarādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreyya, seyyathīdaṃ
an8.43:3.3: Aṅgānaṃ Magadhānaṃ Kāsīnaṃ Kosalānaṃ Vajjīnaṃ Mallānaṃ Cetīnaṃ Vaṃsānaṃ Kurūnaṃ Pañcālānaṃ Macchānaṃ Sūrasenānaṃ Assakānaṃ Avantīnaṃ Gandhārānaṃ Kambojānaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an8.43:3.5: Kapaṇaṃ Visākhe mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbasukhaṃ upanidhāya. 5.
an8.43:4.1: Yāni Visākhe mānusakāni paññāsa vassāni, Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.43:4.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni pañca vassasatāni Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.43:4.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Visākhe vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.43:4.6: idaṃ kho pana me taṃ Visākhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.43:5.1: Yaṃ Visākhe mānusakaṃ vassasataṃ, Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.43:5.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.43:5.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Visākhe vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.43:5.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ Visākhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.43:6.1: Yāni Visākhe mānusakāni dve vassasatāni . . . pe . . .
an8.43:6.4: soḷasa vassasatāni Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.43:6.7: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni soḷasa vassasahassāni Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.43:6.8: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Visākhe vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.43:6.9: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ Visākhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.43:6.10: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbasukhaṃ upanidhāyā ti.
an8.43:7.1: Pāṇaṃ na haññe na cādinnam ādiye
an8.43:7.2: musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā
an8.43:8.1: mālaṃ na dhāraye na ca gandham ācare
an8.43:9.1: Cando ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā
an8.43:10.3: siṅgī suvaṇṇaṃ atha vā pi kañcanaṃ
an8.43:12.1: Tasmā hi nārī ca naro ca sīlavā
